# ELK.js

Vendored elkjs 0.12.0: `elk-api.js` as elk-0.12.0.js and `elk-worker.min.js` as ../workflow-layout-worker.js, unchanged from npm.
Source: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs
License: EPL-2.0, see elk-LICENSE.md.
The browser API computes geometry in a dedicated worker; no external runtime requests.
